name: codeology
description: An educational website with blogs and quizzes on web development

paragraphs: This is a blogging website I had made which also has a section for web development-related quizzes and live projects. The quizzes are coded using JavaScript and the projects are embedded using a third-party site(Codepen). Netflify CMS provides an admin panel where blogs can be added and modified. 11ty is the static site generator and Nunjucks is the templating language for this website. This was the first time I worked with components and I was blown away. I migrated this project to Astro JS which is the cleaner, more performant version - Codeology v2.
